item: a carried article's top keyword never holds a hidden word
summary: The backup merge's carry plan now computes each carried article's top keyword without the shipped stoplist's words (temp.carry_hidden of their local ids, NOT IN on the three top-keyword subqueries), as keyword_fold and the stoplist pass do. Before, a backup whose mentions made a hidden word an article's most frequent one brought that word in as the article's top until the next maintenance window. The test plants such a mention and fails on the old code. Release line: An imported article's top keyword is no longer one of the common words the app hides.
